content.introduction: Today's stock market sector performance shows the Industrials sector leading with a +2.40% increase, followed by Information Technology at +1.67%. The Financials sector saw a modest +0.74% gain, while Utilities and Energy sectors both had slight increases of +0.37% and +0.33%, respectively. Consumer Discretionary, Materials, Health Care, Consumer Staples, Real Estate, and Communication Services all experienced declines, with Communication Services being the worst performer at -1.10%. The S&P 500 closed lower at -1.77%, with Energy leading the sectors at +1.90% and Information Technology lagging at -4.25%.
body:
FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. (FDXF) led the S&P 500 in the last completed session, up 14.91%, followed by Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (REGN, +13.33%), Global Payments Inc. (GPN, +12.97%) and GoDaddy Inc. (GDDY, +10.72%).
On the downside, Reddit, Inc. (RDDT) was the weakest at -29.22%, with Intel Corporation (INTC, -28.58%), Illumina, Inc. (ILMN, -18.64%) and Twilio Inc. (TWLO, -15.24%) also under pressure.

## Sector Performance, Ranked Best to Worst [...] ## Market Pulse

The S&P 500 closed lower in the last completed session at -1.77% (via SPY); the market-cap-weighted average of the 500 members with a price for the session was -1.80%.
Market breadth showed a mixed picture as the index moved lower: 226 stocks advanced and 274 declined out of 500 constituents.
Energy led the sectors at +1.90%, while Information Technology lagged at -4.25%.
